name: Jack Lee
profile: Final-year Computer Science & Information Technology student with 8 months' software engineering experience on Ericsson's CI/CD platform team. Experience building Python automation, cloud-native CI/CD infrastructure, developer tooling, and independent software systems spanning trading, web applications, and AI-assisted workflows.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Independently refactored a monolithic 2,000+ line Python CI module into 14 executor-specific modules across approximately 25 development tasks, designing shared abstractions and runtime parameterisation to reduce duplicated logic and improve maintainability.

Developed and maintained Jenkins/Groovy and Spinnaker pipelines for build, deployment, testing, and cleanup workflows, including migrating test flows to lighter snapshot-based jobs to reduce execution time.

Built release-verification stages for cloud archive packaging and strengthened Artifactory/Nexus checks, identifying an undeclared ELF executable in production builds before release and raising remediation work.

Diagnosed CI/CD and cloud-native failures across Kubernetes, Docker, Helm/Helmfile, and pipeline integrations, including resolving a blocker build regression and root-causing an RBAC cleanup failure to destructive Python file handling.

experience.title: Web Development Intern
bullets: Contributed to client website projects through implementation, QA, and release, delivering responsive PHP/SCSS changes across multiple production sites.
Diagnosed frontend issues and translated client/team feedback into layout, usability, and responsive-design improvements without disrupting established pages.
experience.note: Selected clients: Kerry International Film Festival, MCL Electrical, Anushka Power Therapy, Daily Irish Produce, Capital Homes.

additional_experience.title: Cashier & Kitchen Team Member

projects.title: Dynamic Task Router
bullets: Built a provider-agnostic engineering orchestrator that routes bounded development tasks across local and cloud AI models based on task complexity, risk, and role.
Developed a shared routing/runtime layer exposed through CLI, interactive TUI, and MCP interfaces, with isolated worktrees, verification steps, and multi-provider execution.
Added support for multiple coding/model providers including Codex, Claude Code, Qwen, OpenCode, OpenRouter, and local Ollama workflows.

projects.title: Multi-Broker Trading Research Platform
bullets: Built a modular Python trading research platform integrating IG, Capital.com, and Alpaca across FX, CFDs, and US equities, separating market data, strategy, risk, execution, journaling, analytics, and UI components.

Developed reproducible paper-trading and research infrastructure including multi-broker session orchestration, broker smoke tests, SQLite journaling, automated test/security gates, and VPS-based monitoring.

projects.title: PlanAround
projects.technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Workers, Featherless
bullets: Built a student planning application that converts timetable screenshots and assignment briefs into realistic study schedules around lectures, commitments, and deadlines.

Designed an explainable scheduling system that derives workload from ECTS, assessment weighting, and rubric structure, using AI only for structured extraction while keeping workload and scheduling decisions deterministic.

Implemented automated deployment, alert workflows, and market-specific site behaviour using GitHub Actions and Cloudflare.
